title: tc-activity-clock
description:
Activity by hour, a clock per day: an AM ring and a PM ring of hour segments shaded by how busy each hour was, with
the day in the middle and an hour's value there on hover or focus.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

days.description: The days, a clock each, in the order given

max.description: The value that shades a segment fully; by default the busiest hour across every day shown

levels.description: How many shades, counting empty: 5 is empty and four steps of activity

unit.description: What the values count, after the number: "12 events"

selected.description: The selected hour. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for day names and numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

date.description: The day, as epoch ms of any moment in it; it also identifies the day in `selected`

label.description: Shown under the clock; by default the weekday and the day of the month, e.g. "Tue 27"

values.description: One value per hour from midnight – 24 of them; null (or missing) means no data for that hour
